name: monopoly-simulator
description: Monopoly played by AI models: a Cloudflare Worker site that keeps every game in D1 and shows them live and move by move, with a runner that plays the games from the owner's machine.

scripts.migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --env local
scripts.simulate: node scripts/simulate.mjs 50 standard && node scripts/simulate.mjs 50 mega
scripts.check:replay: node scripts/check-replay.mjs 30 standard && node scripts/check-replay.mjs 30 mega
scripts.check:ledger: node scripts/check-ledger.mjs 30 standard && node scripts/check-ledger.mjs 30 mega
